## Q&A — question or help request

### Before asking

- [ ] I searched existing discussions and issues
- [ ] I read the README and `docs/troubleshooting.md`
- [ ] I checked `release/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`

### Question

What are you trying to do?

### Context

- Version / commit: (e.g. v1.0.0-rc.1)
- Deployment: (local / docker / compose / k8s / helm / distributed)
- Provider(s): (openai / anthropic / google / ollama / ...)
- Request ID (if an error occurred): (from `GET /logs/{request_id}`)

### What I tried

Steps taken, commands run, config excerpts. Do **not** paste API keys.
